current_checkpoint_note: Fertiliser Vertical V1 -- End-to-End Scientific Completion campaign, Checkpoint 2 (Laboratory Evidence), baseline 3df57ec (Checkpoint 1, Soil Sampling Foundation, closed clean 8 rounds). Architecture: docs/product/farm-return-next-v1.1/SOIL_SAMPLING_ARCHITECTURE.md's own CompositeSample -> LabResult -> SoilInterpretation link, now built. New: src/domain/soil-interpretation.ts (interpretLabResult -- reuses nutrients.ts's pIndexFromMgL/kIndexFromMgL/resolvePIndexConservatively/cropGroupForFieldUse/soilMaterialForOrganicCarbonStatus verbatim, no new numeric rule encoded; preserves AMBIGUOUS_STATUTORY_BOUNDARY rather than silently resolving it) with 7 new tests. Two new tables: lab_results (20260913000000, job_session_id unique -- structurally enforces one CompositeSample has at most one LabResult; raw measured values only, insert-only/immutable) and soil_interpretations (20260913010000, insert-only/versioned -- a methodology change adds a row, never rewrites one; most recent row is 'current'). src/lib/farm-data/lab-results.ts + soil-interpretations.ts (farm-data layer, same retry-safe-insert/ cross-farm-trigger patterns as Checkpoint 1). src/orchestration/lab-result/index.ts -- recordLabResultForCompositeSample persists the raw LabResult + a real SoilInterpretation, then calls the EXISTING, UNMODIFIED addSoilTestToField (src/lib/farm-data/soil.ts) to apply the result to Field.fertility -- the same function the legacy manual Soil-screen entry already uses, so Checkpoint 3's already-built, already-audited calculateNutrientPlan picks up this new evidence chain with ZERO engine changes. Fails closed: only attaches to an already-CONFIRMED CompositeSample (session.status === 'confirmed_actual'), rejects a second lab result for the same sample, rejects an unknown/mismatched session. types.ts's SoilTest gained additive compositeSampleId/labResultId provenance fields (non-breaking; every legacy manual entry omits them). src/app/actions/lab-results.ts (submitLabResultAction, getLabStatusForCompositeSampleAction). src/app/actions/soil-sampling.ts's listFieldCompositeSamplesAction extended (additive) to resolve each sample's real status (awaiting_lab_result vs lab_result_received) instead of the Checkpoint 1 permanent placeholder -- CompositeSampleView.status widened accordingly. UI: an inline lab-result entry form added to the soil-sample screen's 'Previous samples' list (enter raw pH/P/K/Mg/OM%/lime, see the resulting P/K Index, including an honest 'conservative -- statutory boundary ambiguity' disclosure when the raw P value falls in the real statutory gap). No document/file-upload infrastructure exists anywhere in this codebase -- confirmed before building anything; LabResult.sourceDocumentRef is a farmer-typed reference only, never a real upload, disclosed honestly rather than implied; building real Storage-backed upload is out of this checkpoint's scope. 6 new orchestration tests (src/orchestration/lab-result/index.test.ts) cover the fail-closed gates and that an AMBIGUOUS P Index outcome survives end to end into the persisted interpretation, never silently resolved. Quality gate: scripts/quality-gate.sh --json, run for real: 2204/2204 tests (159/159 -- the field-awareness date-drift test Checkpoint 1's own round 6 fixed stays fixed), typecheck/lint/build all pass -- overall: pass. A real regression this checkpoint introduced and fixed in the same pass: listFieldCompositeSamplesAction gained a new lab-results dependency that its own existing test file (soil-sampling.test.ts) had not mocked -- caught immediately by the full suite run, fixed by adding the missing mock plus a new real test for the added status-resolution behaviour, never left for a later round to find. Migrations: PENDING_DEV_VALIDATION (no live Supabase credentials in this environment, same disclosed gap as every migration in this checkpoint and its predecessor). Checkpoint 2 Codex audit gate CLOSED (4 rounds: 0/3H all fixed; 1C/1H/1M all fixed; 1C/1H fixed but round 3's own fix was itself incomplete; round 4 correctly rejected round 3's fix and required a real structural correction -- soil_interpretations is now treated purely as a permanent audit trail, never a trusted 'current value' source, with getLabStatusForCompositeSample recomputing interpretLabResult fresh from lab_results instead of reading the table back). Final quality gate: scripts/quality-gate.sh --json, genuinely run: 2213/2213 tests, typecheck/lint/build all pass -- overall: pass. Full round-by-round account: IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md.

Rounds 2-4 found the same underlying structural problem three consecutive times from different angles (authenticated's blanket insert grant on soil_interpretations means no persisted row's column, including created_at, can be trusted to distinguish a genuine interpretation from a client-fabricated one) -- closed with a real structural fix per this campaign's own rule, not a fourth patch: the one real caller needing a displayable interpretation (getLabStatusForCompositeSample) never reads soil_interpretations back at all -- it recomputes interpretLabResult fresh from the real lab_results row every time, the same principle Field.fertility (the actual trusted source every downstream calculation reads) already embodies.
